Pass the Trial of Kalla's Bow: Kalla will offer to lend Leda her bow during a cutscene at the start of Leda's Path Chapter 10. Visit Kalla's Main Temple, speak to the receptionist, and choose Trial to fight in an Event Clash. Winning rewards the bow.
Trial of Kalla's Bow is unmarked: Note that the Trial of Kalla's Bow is an unmarked quest and is exclusive to Leda's Path. It does not appear in the Adventure Log, and will not be accessible after Part 1. Make sure to earn the bow before completing Leda's Part 1 path!
Kalla's Trial is in Part 3: This trial should not be confused with Kalla's Trial from Part 3 of the campaign. That is a separate trial unlocked by completing Kalla's Request, and awards a different divine item.

source_detail.value: Finish Smyrnos' Lv. 60 Trial at his Temple: Agnea's Arrow can be learned by finishing Smyrnos' Ideal Level 60 trial in his Temple in Solidus and acquiring Agnea's Tome. This entire trial will first appear in Part 3 and after completing Smyrnos' Request. Talk to the priest in the temple to start the trial. Being victorious will reward you with the tome and Smyrnos' Channels.

source_detail.value: Find Archive T in Uncharted Island: Dark Spikes T can be learned by acquiring and using the Archive T scroll found in a treasure chest in Uncharted Island, a dungeon found in Castalia region, near the Port of Pandora. Flame Lords will have to travel through Port of Pandora and cross the Pandora Shoal to reach the destination. Theodora can go to this area anytime in her route. Leda, Dietrich and Cai will have to wait until later in their routes to properly access it.
